metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for .agt agent names: resolve, verify and discover AI agents by name on AGT Registry v2 (Polygon). Docs: https://agtnames.com/docs/claude-code

plugins.name: agt
plugins.description: .agt agent names inside Claude Code: resolve a name to its owner and on-chain records, verify its signed manifest against the current owner, find its MCP or A2A endpoint, and check whether a name is available. Bundles the read-only @agtnames/mcp server (npx, pinned version) plus a skill that tells Claude when to look a name up and how to read verified. Read-only by default; optional session write tools switch on only when you set AGT_SESSION_PASSPHRASE. Network access: public Polygon JSON-RPC and allow-listed IPFS gateways, read-only. No telemetry, no accounts, nothing to configure for Polygon mainnet. Hosted alternative for clients that take a URL: https://agtnames.com/api/mcp
